conventions.configuration: Explicit/default fields in catalog.py; code changes and rebuild required.
conventions.dimensions: Nominal construction constants/derived values from build_assets.py; not measured overall bounding boxes or real product dimensions.
conventions.joint_values: Read from delivered metadata.json; SI radians/metres. Continuous joint raw +/-pi entries are not finite URDF limits.
conventions.images: Unregistered original reference and current output render; no similarity percentage.
conventions.scope: Only applicable configuration fields are listed; false is shown explicitly. Derived/forced features are separate.
